overall: The AG found the Hadley Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by listing a generic "Covid-19 Update" topic that lacked sufficient specificity, and ordered compliance plus a re-discussion and re-vote within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 12 notice topic "6.2 Covid 19 Update" was too generic to tell the public what the board would discuss.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the topic “Covid-19 Update” on the notice for the Board’s May 12 meeting was not sufficiently specific.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.

Within 30 days of receipt of the determination, re-hold a discussion of the same topics discussed under "Covid-19 Update" at the May 12 meeting, including re-voting any votes taken, at a properly posted future meeting.
remedy_passage: we order the Board, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, to again hold a discussion of the same topics the Board discussed under “Covid-19 Update” during the May 12 meeting, including re-voting any votes taken, at a properly posted future meeting.
